post.description: Starts grant enrollment for a credential slot of a provider draft whose plugin profile authenticates with a grant: the default slot, or the slot the body names, which re-enrolls a slot's grant. The plugin builds the authorization request, with its state and PKCE, which the operator opens to sign in upstream, or starts a device authorization, whose verification URL and user code the operator approves upstream. The plugin reaches only its approved origins, over the provider's network path and the egress policy. The grant becomes a new credential version staged on the slot like a rotation: re-enrolling the same principal activates as a credential rotation, and another principal changes the provider's serving identity.

422.description: The provider's profile authenticates without a grant (grant_enrollment_unavailable), the named credential slot is unknown (validation_failed), its plugin is unusable (plugin_*), or the plugin failed (grant_enrollment_failed)

delete.description: Cancels a grant enrollment its principal started and has not continued, deleting its session state.

409.description: The grant enrollment was already continued (grant_enrollment_used)

post.description: Continues a grant enrollment that has an authorization URL with what the upstream returned: the plugin exchanges the pasted callback URL or code for a grant. OLP creates a credential version recording the plugin, the observed principal and the grant facts, holds the grant beneath it, and stages it on the enrollment's credential slot. A grant enrollment is continued once, by the principal that started it, before it expires.

409.description: The grant enrollment was already continued (grant_enrollment_used), or the provider's plugin profile or credential slot changed meanwhile (grant_enrollment_stale)

422.description: What was pasted back answers another authorization request (grant_state_mismatch), the plugin could not enroll a grant (grant_enrollment_failed), or its plugin is unusable (plugin_*)

post.description: Reports where a grant enrollment by device authorization stands. Control runs no background jobs, so status requests drive polling: one made once the interval has passed since the last poll runs one plugin poll step, which honours the upstream's slow-down, and any control replica serves the next. Once the operator approves the device upstream, OLP creates a credential version recording the plugin, the observed principal and the grant facts, holds the grant beneath it, and stages it on the enrollment's credential slot. Polling stops when the enrollment completes, is denied, expires or is cancelled. Only the principal that started the enrollment polls it.

404.description: Grant enrollment by device authorization not found

409.description: An earlier poll failed, which ended the grant enrollment (grant_enrollment_used), or the provider's plugin profile or credential slot changed meanwhile (grant_enrollment_stale)

422.description: The plugin could not enroll a grant (grant_enrollment_failed), or its plugin is unusable (plugin_*); either ends the grant enrollment

post.description: Reads every page of the upstream model listing with the published credential version of the active revision and compares it with the published inventory. The comparison changes no draft, revision or certification state. Only the native anthropic adapter with one enabled, stored API-key credential slot is supported.

422.description: The provider has no active revision, or its published listing configuration is not the supported native anthropic adapter with one enabled, stored API-key credential slot

post.description: Validates the supported Codex auth.json token format and exchanges its refresh token through the pinned Codex subscription profile to verify account and user identity. Stores only the verified grant in encrypted OLP storage. OLP owns refresh after import. Stop using the original local credentials. This does not synchronize local files or test inference. An existing slot must retain its principal.

post.description: Validates the supported Claude Code .credentials.json subscription format. Authenticates the original access token at the fixed profile endpoint, then refreshes through the pinned Claude subscription profile and requires the same verified account and organization. Stores only the verified grant in encrypted OLP storage. OLP owns refresh after import. Stop using the original local credentials. This does not synchronize local files or test inference. An existing slot must retain its principal.

post.description: Validates the documented Antigravity migration envelope and its original OAuth client authorization. Authenticates the original access token at fixed userinfo and project endpoints, then refreshes through the trusted Antigravity subscription profile and requires the same verified subject and project. Stores only the verified grant in encrypted OLP storage. OLP owns refresh after import. Stop using the original local credentials. This does not extract IDE stores, synchronize local files or test inference. An existing slot must retain its principal.

input.description: What the upstream returned after the operator signed in: the whole loopback callback URL it redirected the browser to, or the code it displayed.

credential.description: UTF-8 JSON containing proxy_username/proxy_password and/or client_certificate_pem/client_key_pem. Stored encrypted; both client certificate and private key must be supplied together.

model.description:
Optional seed/probe model. Vertex AI requires one because its publisher
model collection has no list operation; other connectors can discover
models after the draft is created.

project_id.description: Owning project; omit or null for an installation-wide provider. Required for assigned principals.

credential_reference.description: Introducing an external reference requires installation-wide settings authority in addition to configure authority.

CredentialGrant.description: What grant enrollment recorded on a credential version, and when the current access token of the grant beneath it expires. Grant material never leaves OLP.

expires_at.description: When the grant's current access token expires, if the upstream said.

facts.description: The grant facts the plugin reported, which the profile's hosting templates use.

lapsed_at.description: When the grant lapsed: it can no longer be refreshed, so the version's slots are ineligible until a new grant enrollment replaces it. Null while the grant lives.

plugin_digest.description: Digest of the plugin whose grant enrollment created the version.

principal.description: The observed principal: the upstream account the grant authorizes.

CredentialRequirement.description: Whether an authentication mode takes a stored credential: `required` takes a pasted credential, `grant` takes credential versions that grant enrollment creates, and `forbidden` takes none.

active.description: True when this credential is used by the immutable runtime revision.

draft_selected.description: True when this credential is selected only by the mutable draft.

grant.description: What grant enrollment recorded, for a version with a grant beneath it; null for a pasted credential.

credential_version_id.description: The credential version the slot serves with. A slot write binds the version it names, which must be neither revoked nor lapsed; one that sends null or omits it keeps the slot's current version unless it stages a pasted credential.

daily_cost_limit.description: Exact decimal amount in the installation currency.

monthly_cost_limit.description: Exact decimal amount in the installation currency.

saturation_percent.description: Usage percentage of the quota above which each class is held to its share.

models.description:
Omit or pass an empty array to query the upstream model-list API.
Manual identifiers are a fallback for upstreams without a list API.
All discovered models start disabled and without capability claims until
the explicit review operation is completed. At most 2,000 entries: the
revision diff cannot read a provider beyond that.

GrantDeviceAuthorization.description: A device authorization the operator approves upstream: they open the verification URL, on any device, enter the user code and approve, while status requests poll the enrollment.

interval.description: How many seconds to wait between status requests.

user_code.description: The code the operator enters at the verification URL.

verification_url.description: Where the operator enters the user code, at one of the plugin's approved origins.

GrantEnrollment.description: A grant enrollment in progress, with either an authorization URL or a device authorization. With an authorization URL, the operator opens it, signs in upstream, and continues the enrollment with what the upstream returns before it expires; it is continued once. With a device authorization, the operator approves the device upstream while status requests poll the enrollment until it completes, is denied or expires. Any control replica serves either.

authorization_url.description: The plugin's authorization request, at one of its approved origins.

expires_at.description: When the enrollment expires: 10 minutes after it starts, or when a device authorization's user code expires, within 30 minutes.

input.description: How the operator continues an enrollment that has an authorization URL. `secret` means the page issues an upstream secret, such as an API key, which the operator pastes; OLP stores it encrypted and never returns it. Absent means the callback URL or code the upstream returns.

slot_id.description: The credential slot the grant will back.

GrantEnrollmentCompletion.description: The credential version grant enrollment created, with the grant beneath it, staged on the enrollment's credential slot of the provider draft like a rotated credential.

principal.description: The observed principal: the upstream account the grant authorizes.

GrantEnrollmentStatus.description: Where a grant enrollment by device authorization stands.

completion.description: The credential version the grant created, once completed.

interval.description: How many seconds to wait before the next status request, while pending. The upstream may ask OLP to slow down, which lengthens it.

status.description: `pending` until the operator approves the device upstream; `completed` once the grant created a credential version; `denied` when the operator denied the device; `expired` when the device authorization expired first.

NetworkCredentialResponse.description: Network credential metadata only; plaintext is never returned.

capabilities.description:
Capability tuples with a safe server-owned certification path for this
provider kind. Configuration validation may support additional future tuples.

created_by_email.description: Email of the operator who created the provider.

presets.description: Reviewed onboarding presets. Empty for provider kinds without presets.

ProviderListingComparisonResponse.description: A comparison of one complete upstream model listing with the published inventory of one active provider revision. An incomplete comparison carries no new, changed or missing-model verdicts. Not listed does not mean retired.

lifecycle.description: The model's deprecation and retirement as the reference catalog documents them, or null when it documents none.

discovery.description: Whether the upstream lists its models; without discovery the connection test needs a declared probe model.

endpoint.description: Reviewed HTTPS base URL resolved into ordinary provider configuration.

id.description: Stable identifier for this immutable catalog entry.

maintainer.description: Organization maintaining the official documentation used for review.

placeholder.description: Whether the endpoint is a placeholder the operator replaces, as for self-hosted runtimes and account-scoped hosts.

profile_id.description: Profile a strict route needs, for a vendor whose reviewed contract is the profile's dialect exactly. Onboarding clients copy it into the configuration; the server never infers it.

ProviderProfile.description: Immutable composition of independently owned dialect, hosting, authentication and transport contracts. Profile registration does not establish interaction fidelity qualification. A plugin profile's revision is the digest of the plugin module that supplies it; the catalogue lists the profiles of approved plugins.

default_schemas.description: Operation-owned JSON Schema objects for supported default controls.

operation_dialects.description: Dialect identity for each supported operation.

model_discovery.description: Whether a plugin profile declares the upstream's model listing. Without it, operators declare the models of a provider using the profile. A built-in profile's provider kind decides its discovery, and it omits this field.

options_schema.description: A plugin profile's options, as the JSON Schema of a provider's plugin_options: a string property per option, in declared order, with required options listed in required. Absent for a built-in profile.

strict.description: Whether the profile may serve strict routes: its hosting changes only authorization, address and headers, or is a qualified built-in binding.

transport.description: How the profile reaches the upstream: http, websocket, or plugin where an unconfined plugin carries its traffic.

ProviderProfilePlugin.description: The installed provider plugin that supplies a profile.

digest.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the plugin module, or of an unconfined plugin's executable, which is the profile revision.

unconfined.description: Set for an unconfined plugin, which runs with native privileges.

ProviderQuotaUsage.description: Storage-independent distributed limiter used by the inference engine.

plugin_changed.description: The revisions pin different provider plugin digests, or only one pins a plugin.

plugin_options_changed.description: The revisions set different values for the plugin profile's options.

serving_binding_changed.description: The revisions declare different serving bindings, or their credential slots observe different upstream principals.

historical_credential_version.description: Historical metadata only. Restore never selects this credential.

credential_restored.description: Always false: historical credential material is never restored.

historical_credential_version.description: Historical metadata only. Restore never selects this credential.

created_by_email.description: Email of the operator who created the provider.

credential_reference.description: Introducing an external reference requires installation-wide settings authority in addition to configure authority.

capabilities.description:
Explicit operator-reviewed capability tuples. New tuples are recorded
as `declared`, tuples already stored keep their provenance, and tuples
left out are removed. Certification/probe jobs promote provenance
separately and cannot be forged by the browser.

lapsed.description:
True when the grant beneath the credential version this slot would
present lapsed. Selection refuses the version, so the slot cannot serve
traffic until its grant is re-enrolled and the provider activated.

revoked.description:
True when the credential version this slot would present has been
revoked. Selection refuses a revoked version, so the slot cannot serve
traffic until a replacement secret is staged and activated.

tokens_per_minute.description: Tokens per minute ceiling every member connection of the group shares.

tokens_this_minute.description: Tokens the shared group counted in the current minute across every member connection.

shared_group_usage.description: Live shared token quota usage by group name for the groups this connection belongs to, so group headroom reads apart from connection and slot usage. Empty when the connection joins no group or the counters cannot be read.

credential_reference.description: Introducing an external reference requires installation-wide settings authority in addition to configure authority.

slot_id.description: The credential slot the grant will back; the provider's default slot when omitted. Naming a slot a grant already backs re-enrolls its grant.

dialects.description: Generation dialects the vendor documents. A profile in another generation dialect is refused for the vendor.

unsupported_parameters.description: Request fields refused for the vendor because its documented API cannot represent them.

CatalogCapabilityHints.description: Capabilities the vendor documents; an absent hint is unknown. Hints never certify a capability.

ProviderCatalogSuggestion.description: The reference catalog's facts for one of a provider's models.

catalog_model.description: Catalog model the upstream model matched.

conflict.description: Why the suggestion cannot be accepted: privacy_evidence when the stored facts attest a privacy declaration.

vendor_id.description: Vendor the provider's models were matched under.

catalog_sha256.description: Digest of the catalog the suggestions were reviewed against; a different catalog answers 409.

credential_version_id.description: The credential version the slot serves with. A slot write binds the version it names, which must be neither revoked nor lapsed; one that sends null or omits it keeps the slot's current version unless it stages a pasted credential.

daily_cost_limit.description: Exact decimal amount in the installation currency.

monthly_cost_limit.description: Exact decimal amount in the installation currency.

saturation_percent.description: Usage percentage of the quota above which each class is held to its share.

last_error_code.description: Stable content-free failure code: credential, status, network, timeout, response or endpoint.

source_revision.description: Identifier of the most recently applied source revision, if the source provides one.

credential.description: Billing credential. Required on create, omitted retains the stored credential, and null is rejected. Cloud credentials are source-shaped objects.

credentials.description: Codex auth.json JSON text. Supports chatgpt auth_mode or its omission, absent or null OPENAI_API_KEY, tokens with access_token, id_token, refresh_token and account_id, and optional RFC3339 last_refresh. Other fields and ambiguous JSON are rejected. Expired local tokens may be imported if refresh verifies the same account and user.

slot_id.description: Existing credential slot, defaults to the default slot

credentials.description: Claude Code .credentials.json JSON text containing only claudeAiOauth with accessToken, refreshToken, expiresAt in epoch milliseconds and scopes including user:profile and user:inference. Optional metadata fields are refreshTokenExpiresAt, subscriptionType, subscriptionTypeSource, subscriptionTypeVerifiedAt, rateLimitTier and clientId. A supplied clientId must match the supported official client. Other fields, alternative credential stores and ambiguous JSON are rejected. The original access token must still authenticate the fixed profile endpoint. Import verifies account and organization before and after refresh, without decoding token claims.

slot_id.description: Existing credential slot, defaults to the default slot

credentials.description: One-time Antigravity migration JSON with type=antigravity, access_token, refresh_token, client_id and client_secret for the original authorized OAuth client. The client_id must match the provider option. Optional pinned export metadata is expired (RFC3339), expires_in, timestamp, email and project_id. Supplied expiry must be current and supplied project_id must agree with authenticated project evidence. Email never establishes identity. Unknown fields, ambiguous JSON, raw IDE stores, service accounts and credentials without original client authorization are unsupported. The original access token must authenticate fixed userinfo and project endpoints. Import refreshes and verifies the same subject and project before encrypted staging.

slot_id.description: Existing credential slot, defaults to the default slot
